description: A skincare routine for one period with its ordered steps (tables ROUTINE, ROUTINE_STEP, ROUTINE_SOURCE).

_id.description: routine_id (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

schema_version.description: Version of the document shape, 1 for schema v1 (allows document-by-document migration later).

user_id.description: owner, reference to users (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

period.description: Period of the day: AM or PM (domain d_period of the Oracle schema).

created_at.description: Creation moment; the latest routine of a period is the current one (UTC)

source_analysis_id.description: optional reference to skin_analyses (table ROUTINE_SOURCE) (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

product_id.description: chosen product, reference to products (UUID, binary subtype 4; the subtype cannot be checked by $jsonSchema)

name.description: Copy of the product name; null when no product is chosen.

brand.description: Copy of the product brand; null when no product is chosen.

instruction.description: Instruction shown to the user, at most 255 characters.
